skill.holy_vampirism.holy_hunter_root.de: Embrace the Sacred Order. Hunters gain scaling Max Health, Natural Armor, Toughness, Speed, and Attack Speed as they level up.
skill.holy_vampirism.silver_edge.desc: Attacks deal +25% bonus damage to Vampires and Undead and briefly apply Glowing and Weakness.
skill.holy_vampirism.holy_fervor.desc: Grants +15% Attack Speed and +15% Movement Speed. Melee critical hits against Vampires restore health.
skill.holy_vampirism.iron_will.desc: Grants +6 Max Health, +4 Armor, +30% Knockback Resistance, and gentle passive regeneration below 50% health.
skill.holy_vampirism.vampiric_ward.desc: Reduces incoming damage from Vampires by 20% and grants immunity to Vampire Freeze.
skill.holy_vampirism.undying_resolve.des: Prevents fatal damage once every 120 seconds, restoring 35% health with powerful protective buffs and knocking back nearby foes.
skill.holy_vampirism.blessed_quiver.desc: Crossbow bolts fly 25% faster, deal +25% damage to Vampires and Undead, have a 35% chance to save ammo, and Stakes deal +15% damage.
skill.holy_vampirism.solar_infusion.desc: Hits against Vampires ignite them with Solar Burn (sun damage over time) and briefly apply Garlic.
action.holy_vampirism.hunters_surge.desc: Dash swiftly forward in a burst of holy light, gaining Speed III and brief fall damage immunity.
action.holy_vampirism.holy_smite.desc: Unleash a radiant shockwave that damages Vampires and Undead, strips Vampire stealth, and empowers you with Strength II and Speed II.
action.holy_vampirism.sanctuary_aura.des: Emit a consecrated aura that heals yourself, allies, and villagers while searing and slowing nearby Vampires and Undead.
action.holy_vampirism.divine_aegis.desc: Gain Absorption III, Resistance II, and Fire Resistance. Unholy attackers striking you suffer Holy thorns and debuffs.
action.holy_vampirism.solar_flare.desc: Detonate artificial sunlight at your target location, dealing heavy sun damage with Garlic, Blindness, and Slowness to Vampires.
message.holy_vampirism.undying_resolve.t: Undying Resolve saved you from death!
command.holy_vampirism.apply.success: Applied %s Holy Vampirism balance overrides to Vampirism config.
command.holy_vampirism.status.player_onl: This command can only be run by a player.
command.holy_vampirism.status.not_hunter: You are not currently a Vampire Hunter.
